document.title: Northwind API Incident Report
document.author: Riley Stone
document.summary: A long operational incident report used to validate PatchPad editing behavior.
sections: 08:41 UTC - Alert triggered for elevated checkout latency.
08:46 UTC - On-call acknowledged and opened a coordination bridge.
09:03 UTC - Cache saturation was suspected but not confirmed.
09:17 UTC - Database connection pool pressure was identified.
Checkout requests were delayed but not lost.
Support received twelve tickets mentioning slow payment confirmation.
No card data was stored by PatchPad or by this report.
